full_judgment: 69. We see that PW 1 stated that all the accused chased him, while PWs 2 and 3 stated that accused Solaiman, Taher and Mukul chased him (PW 1). PW 16 did not support the story of chasing PW 1 by any accused. The mother of PWs 1-3 was withheld without explanation. Joynal Abedin, an uncle of PW 1, who was said to have been informed that the deceased was killed, was also withheld without explanation. So, presumption would be had they (mother and uncle of PW 1) been examined they would not have supported PWs 1-3. Thus we find that none besides PWs 2 and 3, two sisters of PW 1, supported disclosure of the fact of witnessing the occurrence and recognising the accused by PW 1.
